rationale: The plan correctly identifies the paired structure and uses subject as a blocking term in DESeq2 (~subject + condition) with a limma-voom fixed-effect paired sensitivity check, plus a per-subject log2FC decomposition that answers the 'within each subject' phrasing descriptively without inventing per-pair p-values. QC is concrete and design-aware (pairing reconciliation, library sizes, correlation heatmap, PCA colored by subject and shaped by condition with variance explained, explicit no-silent-exclusion policy), filtering is filterByExpr with retained-gene reporting, and normalization stays inside the models (DESeq2 size factors, TMM/voom) with an explicit prohibition on batch-correcting the counts. Contrasts and reference level are explicit, BH at a pre-specified alpha=0.05 with apeglm/ashr shrinkage and no post hoc LFC gating, and the report specifies residual df, power caveats, unpaired-model comparison, and cell-composition confounding. Enrichment is well-scoped (full ranked list with named metric, hallmark and GO BP on symbols, filtered-gene background for ORA, GO redundancy collapsing) but omits collection versions and a min/max gene-set size window; package versions are likewise not required to be reported.
